 Keep it running ────────────────────────────── 
   ↻  Update the server                    u    
   ✓  Check services                       c    
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────╮ 
 │ ↯  Restart all services                 r  │ 
 │    press r again to run                    │ 
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────╯ 
   ±  See what an update brings            n    
   ▣  Check container images               i    
   ⏻  Start, stop or reinstall services    p    
   ⇪  Update interzone

   +  Add a user                           a    
   @  Manage users                         m
